description: This file defines a class `FormatWithSmoker` that implements the `ValueFormatter` interface. The class provides a method `getFormattedValue` which formats an input value to return the string 'Smoker' if truthy, or null otherwise.

classes.name: FormatWithSmoker
classes.description: A class that implements `ValueFormatter` to convert a boolean or presence indicator into the string 'Smoker' or null.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns 'Smoker' if the input `$entityValue` is truthy, null otherwise.
